Healthier habits. A clearer digital experience.

AI Nutrition

01 / The project

What it is

This project is an AI-powered nutrition app and landing page designed to help users build healthier eating habits through personalised recommendations and a clear, engaging digital experience.

The experience is designed for people looking for approachable nutrition guidance and a simple way to understand personalised suggestions across mobile and web.

02 / The challenge

What it needs to solve

Present AI-powered nutrition guidance in a way that feels simple, trustworthy and easy to use: explain recommendations clearly, guide healthier choices, balance functionality with a friendly identity, and maintain consistency across mobile and web.

03 / Design thinking

The approach

A clean, vibrant interface combines modern UI patterns with organic visual elements. Green, yellow and natural food imagery create a friendly health and wellness direction.

The experience is built around clarity, approachable health communication and a simple user flow. Clear visual hierarchy and readable content help users understand the product and take action without feeling overwhelmed.

A mobile-first product experience connects personalised recommendation screens with a conversion-focused landing page, supported by a reusable visual system and UI components.

04 / The experience

How it works

  1. Understand the product

    A clear landing page introduces the nutrition experience, explains its purpose and gives users an obvious next step.

  2. Explore personalised guidance

    Mobile screens and AI recommendation flows organise nutrition information around an approachable, readable interface.

  3. Move from interest to action

    Consistent calls to action and responsive layouts connect the product story across mobile and web.

The design balances branding and usability, pairing a friendly health direction with clear product storytelling.
